The Business

I run a small mobile mechanic service in Tempe, bringing routine automotive maintenance and straightforward repairs to customers at home. The business focuses on convenient, affordable service for students, friends, families, and local drivers who prefer to have the mechanic come to them.

Alongside my engineering studies, this business is part of my practical work with mechanical systems, routine maintenance, and repair.

Automotive Services

Routine Maintenance

Oil changes, engine and cabin filter replacement, and wiper blade replacement.

Brake Service

Brake pad and rotor replacement as part of the mobile service offering.

Batteries & Ignition

Battery replacement and spark plug service.

Belts & Light Repairs

Serpentine belt replacement and select straightforward repairs. Send your vehicle details to discuss a specific job.

Business Launch

The announcement and service guide shared when I introduced the mobile mechanic service on Instagram in September 2026.

Follow the Work

Visit my Instagram for business updates and service inquiries. For a quote, send your vehicle's year, make, model, engine, and a description of the work you need.
